# Simplicity.IO

> Small Android apps by one developer. Contact: simplicity.io.dev@outlook.com

## Apps

- [Mainline Module Info](https://simplicity-io.github.io/mainline-module-info/) ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.simplicity.trainspotting)): shows which Google Play system (Mainline) modules a device runs and tracks their updates. Android 10+ (API 29). Module history is stored on-device.
- [Linux Terminal Helper](https://simplicity-io.github.io/linux-terminal-helper/) ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.simplicity.toybox)): guides you through turning on Android's built-in Linux Terminal (Debian in a virtual machine, on Google Pixel and other supported devices with Android 15 QPR2 or later) and opens it with one tap. Android 15+ (API 35).

## Documentation

- [AI Capability Check: questions and answers](https://simplicity-io.github.io/ai-capability-check/faq/) (also in Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese): how the on-device AI benchmark works, supported phones, privacy, scores and result labels.
- [AI Capability Check: test methodology](https://simplicity-io.github.io/ai-capability-check/methodology/): tests, models, processors, timing, answer checks and scoring.
